title: OpenAI's First Hardware Revealed: Ice Hockey Size, Screenless Design, Price Between $300 and $400

content_html:
More details about OpenAI's first hardware product have recently been leaked, and the device, designed to provide round-the-clock AI assistant services, is gradually becoming clearer. According to insiders, the product is a smart speaker without a display, resembling the second-generation Amazon Echo Dot or a hockey puck in appearance and size, featuring a circular design, with an expected retail price ranging from $300 to $400. The device was developed in collaboration with LoveFrom, the design company founded by Jony Ive, former chief designer of Apple, signaling the official launch of OpenAI's new hardware product line.

In terms of functionality, the device will be equipped with a more advanced AI model, primarily serving as a daily voice assistant, with an interactive experience similar to the ChatGPT voice conversation on iPhone, and it will gradually learn and adapt to users' personal habits during use. In terms of design, the device features high-quality metal materials and refined fabric finishes, and includes components that can move autonomously when responding to user input. Unlike regular smart speakers, this device is battery-powered for portable use and is equipped with a camera that can transmit captured visual information in real time to the ChatGPT large model, achieving multimodal perception capabilities.

Hardware Breakthrough Under the Shadow of Apple's Lawsuit

The product comes at a time when Apple has filed a trade secret lawsuit against OpenAI, accusing it of stealing Apple's technology, including metal processing techniques. Sources say that OpenAI has already evaluated the technical stack of the product internally, believing that the design details of the device could potentially counter the infringement allegations. This suggests that OpenAI may have adopted an independent technology route for hardware development rather than relying on processes obtained from Apple, but whether it will ultimately be sufficient to deal with the legal challenges remains to be seen.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI首款硬件产品的更多细节近日被泄露，该设备旨在提供全天候AI助手服务，逐渐变得清晰起来。 据业内人士透露，该产品是一款没有显示屏的智能音箱，外观和尺寸类似于第二代亚马逊 Echo Dot 或冰球，采用圆形设计，预计零售价在 300 美元至 400 美元之间。 该设备与苹果前首席设计师 Jony Ive 创立的设计公司 LoveFrom 合作开发，标志着 OpenAI 全新硬件产品线的正式推出。

功能上，该设备将搭载更先进的AI模型，主要作为日常语音助手，具有类似iPhone上ChatGPT语音对话的交互体验，并在使用过程中逐渐学习和适应用户的个人习惯。 在设计方面，该设备采用优质金属材料和精致的织物饰面，并包括在响应用户输入时可以自主移动的组件。 与普通智能音箱不同的是，该设备采用电池供电，便于便携式使用，并配备摄像头，可以将捕捉到的视觉信息实时传输至ChatGPT大模型，实现多模态感知能力。

苹果诉讼阴影下的硬件突破

该产品发布之际，苹果公司对 OpenAI 提起商业秘密诉讼，指控其窃取苹果的技术，包括金属加工技术。 消息人士称，OpenAI 已经在内部评估了该产品的技术堆栈，认为该设备的设计细节有可能反驳侵权指控。 这表明OpenAI可能采用了独立的技术路线进行硬件开发，而不是依赖从苹果获得的流程，但最终是否足以应对法律挑战还有待观察。
